note: vespera_macro (round-18 parser audit): a flattened member serde reads without taking its keys (a struct with a flatten field of its own, an internally tagged / untagged enum, or a newtype / transparent wrapper around one) has those keys rejected in the request view under the outer deny_unknown_fields (properties {not: {}}, an opaque member no longer opens the object) and typed by every flattened map, also one declared after it; a flattened newtype or transparent wrapper around a map gets a {Name}Input request view like a bare map; a garde pattern with anything but digits and one comma inside a counted repetition ({3, 4}, { 5 }) is skipped as Rust-only regex syntax; a non-finite #[schema(example = ..)] (1e999, -1e999, an over-long integer) is a spanned compile error instead of null; doc and test fixes.
